episodes.200262: On the evening of March 21, 2025, an area of showers and thunderstorms swept through northeast Missouri, into west central and central Illinois.  These thunderstorms were severe with minor property damage, several reports of trees down, and winds measured over 60 mph at one point in Illinois.
episodes.200343: A surface low pressure system over the Great Lakes brought a cold front into central Illinois during the evening of March 21, 2025. Scattered showers and thunderstorms developed near the front, resulting in a few instances of wind damage across central Illinois.
episodes.200527: Widely scattered showers developed across western Kansas and led to a 59 mph wind gust at the Goodland Airport.
episodes.200599: On the evening of March 21, 2025, an area of showers and thunderstorms swept through northeast Missouri, into west central and central Illinois.  These thunderstorms were severe with several reports of trees down and winds measured over 60 mph at one point.
episodes.200635: An upper level trough and associated surface cold front approached from the west. Convective showers initiated along the front and produced damaging wind gusts across the waters.
episodes.201154: A stationary front stretching across the Atlantic and an induced trough over the northeastern Caribbean produced lighter winds and aided in the development of slow-moving showers from streamers over northeastern Puerto Rico.
